declarations.type:
∀ (cached current : SearchLoopCacheIdentity.SemanticKey),
  SearchLoopCacheIdentity.decideSemanticReuse cached current = SearchLoopCacheIdentity.CacheDecision.reuse ↔
    cached = current
declarations.name: SearchLoopCacheIdentity.semantic_reuse_iff_exact_key

declarations.type:
∀ (cached current : SearchLoopCacheIdentity.SemanticKey),
  cached ≠ current →
    SearchLoopCacheIdentity.decideSemanticReuse cached current = SearchLoopCacheIdentity.CacheDecision.invalidate
declarations.name: SearchLoopCacheIdentity.semantic_key_drift_invalidates

declarations.type:
∀ (current : SearchLoopCacheIdentity.SemanticKey) (entry : SearchLoopCacheIdentity.CacheEntry),
  entry.key ≠ current →
    (SearchLoopCacheIdentity.reconcile current entry).state = SearchLoopCacheIdentity.EntryState.stale
declarations.name: SearchLoopCacheIdentity.reconcile_drift_is_stale

declarations.type:
∀ (current : SearchLoopCacheIdentity.SemanticKey) (entry : SearchLoopCacheIdentity.CacheEntry),
  (SearchLoopCacheIdentity.reconcile current entry).state = SearchLoopCacheIdentity.EntryState.valid →
    entry.key = current
declarations.name: SearchLoopCacheIdentity.reconciled_valid_implies_exact_key
